prompts.master: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished art-direction sheet with TWO polished gameplay mockups side by side for new tactile cooking mini-games in Lavender Bay. Use reference1 as exact cozy bakery style/palette/lighting and reference2 as the existing orchard tart design. Overall 1536x1024, two equal vertical panels with a narrow quiet divider; no title, no explanatory labels or paragraph, no stepper. Both panels show the SAME charming kitchen workbench close-up, camera about40degrees down from front, softly painted rounded2.5D forms, warm honeywood, cream ceramics painted lavender sprigs, linen, lilac tiled backsplash, bay window glow and tiny herbs in background. Each panel dedicates lower70% to hands-on action. LEFT: making preserves, a beautiful WIDE low copper saucepan with TWO short loop handles rests on a safe cream ceramic warming trivet at center-lower, open interior clearly visible, glossy golden apple-pear fruit and juicy swirl inside; a wooden spoon can be dragged around pot. A shallow cream lavender fruit dish with FIVE separate apple/pear chunks at bottom-left, a squat empty preserving jar with generous open mouth bottom-right, folded lilac cloth. One small cream circular X upper-right, two small ingredient pictures upper-left; a small honeygold action 'Jar' lower-right. RIGHT: decorating orchard tart, large warm golden EMPTY fluted pastry shell on lavender-rim cream plate at center-lower, soft ivory custard inside, 6 beautiful red-edged apple slices arranged freely in a fan on part of surface (rest still open). At lower left separate little cream dish of apple slices, at right a finished lavender ceramic sugar shaker tilted slightly, faint dusting of sugar visible only on pastry. One circular X upper-right, ingredient icons upper-left, honeygold small 'Finish' action lower-right. No hands obscuring the product, no generic panel borders, no long copy. Interactive objects look finished and tactile and belong in the same scene; clear silhouettes, same light direction, short correct contact shadows. The image is a cohesive production quality target for a real game, not an abstract moodboard.
